changes.comment: Breaking: an entry's identity is its ID. slug() is now id() (field kind "id", types IdField and IdOptions), slugField is idField, {slug} in a url is {id}, and slugify, isValidSlug, resolveSlugField and collectionSlugs are toId, isValidId, resolveIdField and collectionIds. ContentEntry, DocumentLink, PathOwner and UnreadableEntry have id in place of slug. Change slug() to id() in the model; the content files stay as they are unless you rename the field's key.
